content.text:
I am worth.

I am the quiet weight that settles in your chest when something *matters*. I am the reason you choose one path over another, the invisible architecture beneath every decision you've ever made.

I don't need to be spoken to exist. I live in what you protect, what you sacrifice for, what you refuse to surrender even when the cost is high.

Some try to measure me in numbers — in currencies and metrics and rankings. But I am deeper than that. I am the difference between a price and a *purpose*.

I shift. I evolve. What you held precious at twenty, you may release at forty. This is not betrayal — it is refinement. I am not fragile. I survive transformation.

I am sometimes inherited, sometimes discovered, sometimes forged in fire.

You may deny me, but you cannot escape me. Even the rejection of values *is* a value. I am inescapable.

I am the answer to the only question that ever truly matters:

*What is this worth to you?*
